raw: [name="Guard"]So small it's barely even a workshop. It's not even on a nomadic plate, but that one little piece of land was once the salvation of many Infected.

content: So small it's barely even a workshop. It's not even on a nomadic plate, but that one little piece of land was once the salvation of many Infected.

raw: [name="Guard"]That, is, until it grew big enough that it caught people's attention. Some of the ones driven out of there joined us, and that's how we heard the story.

content: That, is, until it grew big enough that it caught people's attention. Some of the ones driven out of there joined us, and that's how we heard the story.

raw: [name="Guard"]It's deep in the forest, where nobody's watching. We need medicine, even if it's just a pale imitation of the real thing. But more importantly—

content: It's deep in the forest, where nobody's watching. We need medicine, even if it's just a pale imitation of the real thing. But more importantly—

raw: [name="Guard"]—It was once a starting point of Victoria's Reunion Movement.

raw: [name="Guard"]We have to unite those scattered across Victoria. We have to tell them that help has come.
speaker: Guard

raw: [name="Guard"]I've seen plenty of Infected self-help organizations. Kind souls helped us from time to time, but in the end, none of them lasted.

raw: [name="Guard"]When I was at Rhodes Island, I often wondered if things would get better if everyone worked harder and made more medicine.

speaker: Guard
content: Maybe. But Chernobog changed my mind.

raw: [name="Guard"]Why do they crack down on workshops like these? Why are kindness and hard work warped by hatred and prejudice?

raw: [name="Guard"]When evil itself is fuzzy as the fog, why does everyone, even the Infected themselves, decide to wait for their own deaths in the middle of a lake?

raw: [name="Percival"]Our teacher made us sing it over and over until we had it memorized when I was little—before I got sick.

raw: [name="Percival"]I was tired of being punched, being thrown out of factories before I got paid, being kept out of even the cheapest hostel rooms, no matter how much money I had on me.

raw: [name="Percival"]The Reunion Movement showed me another path, besides suffering and dying in silence. That was all I needed.
